title: GCD Treasury
statement: Given n piles of coins a_i and a number x, a pirate repeatedly picks a nonempty pile with gcd(a_i, x) ≠ 1, steals g = gcd(a_i, x) coins from it, and sets x to g. The task is to maximize the total number of coins stolen, with n, x and a_i up to 3·10^5 and the sum of n bounded by 3·10^5.
